name: ch05_first_script-webmap
caption: Interactive: pan, zoom, switch layers and basemaps, change the overlay opacity.

name: ch05-dem-grey
caption: The same data as the next map, stretched from 0 m (black) to 1,200 m (white). It answers 'how high', but slowly.

name: ch05-dem-palette
caption: A palette over the same 0 to 1,200 m range. The central highlands of Borneo separate from the coastal lowlands at a glance.

name: ch05-lonlat
caption: One flipped sign moves the point about 120 km. Swapping the two numbers entirely gives a latitude of 117°, which does not exist.
